;PROBE for unreal-asm
         org  60000
START    ld   a,7*3+1/2
         ld   hl,-1/2
         ld   bc,100?7
         ld   de,"AB"
         defb "a",-1,#FF,%101
         defw START,$
         defs 3
         defm "Hi"
         ld   hx,5
         ld   a,ly
         slia b
         ld   (iy-3),7
         ld   (ix+2),a
         jr   START
         rst  #10
         put  62000
HERE     ld   hl,HERE
         nop
         org  60200
         defw HERE
         ent  START
